title: Asbestos Work Permit
name: Asbestos Work Permit
description: Permit control for planned work involving known asbestos-containing materials, including licensing / notification status, plan of work, enclosure, RPE, waste and clearance controls.

fields.label: Asbestos Survey / Register Reference and Revision
Plan of Work / Method Statement Reference

sections.title: WORK CLASSIFICATION, LICENSING AND NOTIFICATION
items: The asbestos survey / register information is sufficient for the planned intrusive work
The ACM type, condition and likely fibre-release potential have been assessed
The employer / contractor has determined whether the work is licensable, notifiable non-licensed work or non-licensed work
Where licensed work is required, a current HSE asbestos licence has been verified
Where notification is required, the appropriate enforcing authority has been notified and the required notification period / conditions are satisfied
The plan of work covers asbestos risks and other health and safety risks arising from the task
Work will stop and be reassessed if unexpected or additional suspect material is encountered

fields.label: HSE Asbestos Licence Number / Expiry (if licensable)

sections.title: WORK AREA, ENCLOSURE AND EXPOSURE CONTROLS
items: The work area is segregated from other workers and the public with suitable warning signs and access control
Enclosure, local extraction, wetting or other dust-control methods match the plan of work
Negative-pressure / extraction equipment is correctly installed and checked where an enclosure is required
Air movement will not spread asbestos fibres to clean areas
Tools and work methods are selected to minimise breakage and fibre release
Contaminated surfaces and equipment can be cleaned before leaving the controlled area
Emergency arrangements cover enclosure failure, loss of extraction, accidental damage and personnel emergencies

fields.label: Enclosure / Air Management Details and Equipment IDs
Enclosure Integrity / Smoke Test Reference (if applicable)

sections.title: COMPETENCE, RPE, PPE AND DECONTAMINATION
items: Workers and supervisors have training appropriate to the class of asbestos work
RPE selection is based on the risk assessment and expected exposure
Tight-fitting RPE users have a current face-fit test for the exact make / model used
RPE is inspected, maintained and used correctly
Protective clothing and footwear controls prevent spread of contamination
Suitable decontamination arrangements are available before work starts
Medical surveillance requirements have been checked where applicable

sections.title: AIR MONITORING, ANALYST AND CLEARANCE
items: Air monitoring requirements have been determined from the risk assessment / plan of work
Where required, a competent UKAS-accredited analytical organisation has been appointed
The analyst is sufficiently independent of the removal contractor for the required clearance activity
For licensed enclosure work, four-stage clearance / certification for reoccupation will be completed where required
The area will not be released for normal occupation until the required clearance criteria are met

fields.label: Clearance Requirement
options: Four-stage clearance / Certificate for Reoccupation required
Other clearance defined in plan of work

sections.title: ASBESTOS WASTE
items: Asbestos waste will be suitably contained, sealed and labelled
Waste will move through a controlled route that prevents contamination of clean areas
The waste carrier and receiving facility are authorised for the waste being transported
Required hazardous waste / consignment documentation will be completed and retained
Temporary waste storage is secure and protected from damage or unauthorised access

sections.title: AUTHORIZATION AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Permit issuer has verified the work classification, plan of work and key controls before start
Work is complete and all asbestos waste and contaminated consumables are controlled
Required clearance / reoccupation evidence has been received before barriers are removed
The asbestos register / records will be updated to show removed, remaining or encapsulated ACMs
The area is safe for hand-back subject to any recorded restrictions
